Technical Skill :- 
 Senior Developer - ExtJS, Java, Spring MVC, Jquery  

 6+ years of experience in the UI skillls , EXT JS Technologies, Java, Spring, JQuery, JSP HTML HTML 5.0, Sencha
 5+ years of experience with UI Deveopment / J2EE (More experience on UI side is desirable)
 Extensive experience developing reports, dashboards, and integrating the UI with middle tier / backend
 GXT and NodeJS Knowledge is nice to have
 Solid understanding of UI Design concepts
 Technical team management experience including offshore team members 
 Retail / Media ratings related experience a plus 
 Hands on development in UI reporting and Performance tuning 
 Responsible for overall UI design and development 
 Lead UI development Team 
 Mediaview Application Platform development.
 Work with the application development teams throughout the development life cycle 
 Ability to take initiative and ownership on tasks
 Create High and Detail design document based on the business requirement 
 Create/Update layouts dynamic dashboards as per the requirements 
 Good written and oral communication
 Explain complex design items through documents and white-board sessions 
 

 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 12+ Months
